story: Up 26 in the first half, the Knicks trailed 96–94 with 3.2 seconds left. Mikal Bridges won it at the buzzer, 97–96.
aria: Animated Short: Mikal Bridges' 3-pointer at the buzzer off Josh Hart's inbounds pass that turned a 96–94 deficit into a 97–96 Knicks win over Portland. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
